name: site-to-ios-app
description: Suede AI workflow for turning a live website, PWA, dashboard, or marketplace into an iOS app. Use when the user has a site or web app and asks to put it on the App Store, wrap it in an app, ship an iOS version, or convert a PWA to native. Produces SITE_TO_IOS_AUDIT.md and SITE_TO_IOS_PLAN.md: URL audit, shell-vs-native strategy, App Store Guideline 4.2 wrapper risk and the native value that mitigates it, current SDK, privacy manifest, age rating, login and payment checks, kids-app rules, QA matr
author: JasonColapietro
